title: SemEval-2026 Task 7: Everyday Knowledge Across Diverse Languages and Cultures
reasoning: The paper describes a shared task (BLEnD) focused on evaluating LLMs' cultural adaptability and everyday knowledge across diverse languages. While it includes topics like traditional holidays and celebrations, its primary focus is on factual everyday life (food, sports, education, etc.) rather than religious traditions, moral frameworks, or ethical reasoning.
